proof_body:
by
  intro R K _ _ _ _ _ _ f g hf hg h
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.eq_map_mul_C_of_dvd K hf h
  rw [hg.leadingCoeff, Polynomial.C_1, mul_one] at hg'
  refine ⟨g', ?_, hg'⟩
  refine Polynomial.monic_of_injective (IsFractionRing.injective R K) ?_
  rw [hg']
  exact hg
target_source: ∀ (R K : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] (f : Polynomial R) (g : Polynomial K), f.Monic → g.Monic → g ∣ f.map (algebraMap R K) → ∃ g' : Polynomial R, g'.Monic ∧ g'.map (algebraMap R K) = g
